ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a square coil, the dashed vertical axis is labeled OO', passing through the middle of the coil; the uniformly distributed “×” around it indicates that the magnetic field direction is perpendicular to the paper surface inward, and B is labeled in the figure. When the coil is in the position shown, the plane of the coil coincides with the paper surface, while the magnetic field is perpendicular to the plane of the coil, so at this time the magnetic flux through the coil is maximum. After the coil rotates 90° around the OO' axis, the plane of the coil is parallel to the direction of the magnetic field, and the magnetic flux through the coil becomes 0. Then reason: It is known that the number of turns N=100, side length a=10 cm=0.10 m, magnetic flux density B=0.1 T, rotational speed f=10 r/s. The coil area S=a^2=(0.10)^2=0.01 m^2. For each turn, from the initial position to rotating through 90°, the magnitude of the magnetic flux change is ΔΦ=BS-0=0.1×0.01=0.001 Wb. The magnetic linkage change of 100 turns is NΔΦ=100×0.001=0.1 Wb. The time used to rotate through 90° is one quarter of a period, Δt=1/(4f)=1/(4×10)=1/40=0.025 s. The magnitude of the average induced voltage E_avg=NΔΦ/Δt=0.1/0.025=4 V.

再推理：已知匝数 N=100，边长 a=10 cm=0.10 m，磁感应强度 B=0.1 T，转速 f=10 r/s。线圈面积 S=a^2=(0.10)^2=0.01 m^2。每匝从初始位置到转过 90° 的磁通量变化大小为 ΔΦ=BS-0=0.1×0.01=0.001 Wb。100 匝的磁链变化量为 NΔΦ=100×0.001=0.1 Wb。转过 90° 用时为四分之一个周期，Δt=1/(4f)=1/(4×10)=1/40=0.025 s。平均感应电压大小 E_avg=NΔΦ/Δt=0.1/0.025=4 V。
